entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves to 30.35.0.5 (fork commit `cd6f9e5ececf`), which now provides the query-shape, dialect and series-select rewrites BenchBox applied itself, so every SQL rewrite resolves from the fork.

Transactional operation scripts, TPC-DS maintenance statements for MySQL and SingleStore, NYC Taxi queries, SingleStore vector queries and the T-SQL tuning metadata statements now go through the SQL translator instead of platform-specific text edits; SingleStore epoch differences and T-SQL existence guards render in the translator form.
